<!-- B"H
Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

Tiferes joins Chesed's structured body and Gevurah's truthful status: the Awtsmoos is one before both, while Awtsmoos.com lets domain meaning and HTTP meaning meet without either swallowing the other in night.
-->
# Phase Three — Final Design

Create a small `MalchusH3HttpResponse` adapter. It receives a handler body, derives the transport status from a legal `body.status` only when `body.ok === false`, otherwise uses 200, and delegates JSON envelope construction to the Awtsmoos dynamic-server `makeJsonResponse` helper.

Rewrite `_awtsmoos.derech.js` fully so each route calls one local `reveal(handlerPromise)` function that awaits the domain body and passes it through `MalchusH3HttpResponse.fromBody`.

Add a focused transport test that uses the actual framework normalizer/sender with a fake Node response vessel. It must prove 200/400/503 status lines and unchanged JSON bodies.

Then run the existing full deterministic suite, safe local/public API probes, and production UI browser suite. The paid MiniMax boundary remains external while `configured:false`.
